topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it. Of all the teachers at this huge school, my child ends up with Ms. Thompson. The very name sends chills down my spine. I remember her class as a battlefield, where every battle was lost before it even began. How can I face her again, let alone entrust my child to her? I need to find a way to make this work, but the memories are overwhelming. There has to be a solution, a way to ensure my child's year isn't defined by the same struggles I faced. I have to be strong, for my child’s sake, but where do I even start?
